ranks: Final Fantasy (FIN, 2025-06-13) and Final Fantasy Commander (FIC, 2025-06-13): the rest of the sets

authored.name: Exdeath, Void Warlock // Neo Exdeath, Dimension's End
Garland, Knight of Cornelia // Chaos, the Endless
Sidequest: Catch a Fish // Cooking Campsite
Sidequest: Hunt the Mark // Yiazmat, Ultimate Mark
Sidequest: Play Blitzball // World Champion, Celestial Weapon

blocked.name: Aerith Rescue Mission
blocked.why: Take 59 Flights of Stairs' 'Put a stun counter on one of them' is a choice among the spell's own legal targets made as it resolves (the ruling); choose-permanents can't be limited to the targets, and a resolution-time modal can't drop a mode whose target went illegal.

blocked.name: Avalanche of Sector 7
blocked.why: "Whenever an opponent activates an ability of an artifact they control" includes mana abilities (a Treasure, a mana rock — the card doesn't exclude them), but the activates-ability trigger never sees a mana ability.

blocked.name: Balthier and Fran
blocked.why: "Whenever a Vehicle crewed by Balthier and Fran this turn attacks" needs a record of which creatures crewed a Vehicle this turn, which the engine does not keep.

blocked.name: Beatrix, Loyal General
blocked.why: "Attach any number of Equipment you control to target creature you control" chooses the Equipment (not targets) as it resolves; choose-permanents' then replaces the ability's targets with each chosen permanent, so the targeted creature can't be named, and making the Equipment targets would change fizzling and targeting.

blocked.name: Blue Mage's Cane
blocked.why: The granted attack trigger's "You may cast the copy by paying {3} rather than paying its mana cost": cast-now offers only the card's own cost or a free cast, never a fixed alternative mana cost (the exile from defending player's graveyard and the copy are expressible — Renegade Bull's shape).

blocked.name: Campsite Cuisine
blocked.why: "You may sacrifice X Foods. When you do, up to X target attacking creatures each get +3/+3 …": a reflexive ability's target count can't be the number sacrificed (an any-number group's max is a number or the spell's X).

blocked.name: Cecil, Dark Knight // Cecil, Redeemed Paladin
blocked.why: "Whenever Cecil deals damage" triggers once per damage event with the total (Vessel of the All-Consuming's ruling), but deals-damage fires once per recipient — with trample or two blockers Cecil would lose life and check/transform twice, transforming back on the second.

blocked.name: Chaos Shrine's Black Crystal
blocked.why: The linked exile is fine, but nothing puts a chosen creature card exiled with the source onto the battlefield (with a finality counter).

blocked.name: Cid, Timeless Artificer
blocked.why: 'A deck can have any number of cards named Cid, Timeless Artificer': deck validation's singleton exemption is basic lands only (the +1/+1 anthem itself is expressible: two grantPtPerCount statics, battlefield and inGraveyard).

blocked.name: Coin of Fate
blocked.why: The effect reads 'the exiled cards' its cost exiled and has an opponent choose one to go to the library bottom while the other returns tapped; neither the cost-exiled reference nor that opponent choice exists.

blocked.name: Crystal Fragments // Summon: Alexander
blocked.why: Chapters I-II 'Prevent all damage that would be dealt to creatures you control this turn' is a rule over a filter (rule 611.2c, so later arrivals are covered too); per-object prevent-damage shields would miss them.

blocked.name: Duelist's Flame
blocked.why: 'Target blocked creature you control' has no CardFilter clause (only unblocked; attacking + unblocked:false wrongly matches an attacker before blockers are declared).

blocked.name: Edgar, King of Figaro
blocked.why: Two-Headed Coin — "the first time you flip one or more coins each turn, those coins come up heads and you win those flips" — needs a static that fixes coin results (and wins flips with no winner), which flip-coin has no hook for.

blocked.name: Edgar, Master Machinist
blocked.why: "If you cast a spell this way, that artifact enters tapped": castFromGraveyard (Karador's once-per-turn permission) has no enters-tapped rider on spells cast through it.

blocked.name: Elixir
blocked.why: "Shuffle all nonland cards from your graveyard into your library" has no effect kind (shuffle-into-library moves only a battlefield permanent), nor the count of cards shuffled this way for the life gain.

blocked.name: Estinien Varlineau
blocked.why: "X is the number of your opponents who were dealt combat damage by Estinien Varlineau or a Dragon this turn": no amount counting players damaged this turn by sources matching a filter (combatDamagedPlayersThisTurn is per object and forgotten when a Dragon leaves the battlefield).

blocked.name: Fated Clash
blocked.why: 'You may cast this spell as though it had flash if a creature is attacking and a creature is blocking' is a conditional flash printed on the spell itself, which has no vocabulary.

blocked.name: Garland, Royal Kidnapper
blocked.why: become-monarch takes no target player, there's no 'whenever an opponent becomes the monarch' trigger, and gain-control has no 'for as long as they're the monarch' duration.

blocked.name: Heidegger, Shinra Executive
blocked.why: 'tokens equal to the number of opponents who control more creatures than you' needs a per-player count; opponent-controls-more only asks whether some opponent does.

blocked.name: Helitrooper
blocked.why: "Equip abilities you activate that target this creature cost {2} less to activate": abilityCostModification can't single out equip abilities, nor read what an ability targets.

blocked.name: Hildibrand Manderville // Gentleman's Rise
blocked.why: "When Hildibrand Manderville dies, you may cast it from your graveyard as an Adventure until the end of your next turn": no graveyard cast permission limited to an adventurer card's Adventure face, lasting until the end of your next turn.

blocked.name: Ice Magic
blocked.why: Blizzara's 'Target creature's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library': put-on-library has a fixed position, and no modal/each-player-may can hand the choice to the target's owner (each-player-may's controllerOfTarget is the controller, which differs for a stolen creature).

blocked.name: Judgment of Alexander
blocked.why: No turn-long 'prevent all damage dealt to you by sources your opponents control' and no 'whenever damage from a creature is prevented this way' trigger for each commander creature to deal damage back.

blocked.name: Kain, Traitorous Dragoon
blocked.why: "If they do" after "that player gains control of Kain" needs to know the control change happened; a conditional reads the source from its current controller's side (so 'controlled by an opponent' is false once the player controls it), and the common failure — the player dealt the damage having lost to it before the trigger resolves — can't be told apart from success without a this-way record of the control change.

blocked.name: Light of Judgment
blocked.why: "Destroy up to one Equipment attached to that creature" is a resolution-time choice among the permanents attached to the target, and no CardFilter clause or choose-permanents form names the object in a target slot as the host.

blocked.name: Lightning, Security Sergeant
blocked.why: 'You may play that card for as long as you control Lightning': impulse-exile's while-source duration checks only that the source is on the battlefield, not that its controller still controls it (the ruling: a change of control ends it for good).

blocked.name: Lord Jyscal Guado
blocked.why: The intervening-if "if you put a counter on a creature this turn": no turn stat for counters you've put on creatures.

blocked.name: Memories Returning
blocked.why: Alternating picks from the five revealed cards — you take one, the chosen opponent bottoms one, you take one, they bottom one, the last goes to hand: look-and-choose's chooser is a public-zone (graveyard) option only, with no revealed pool shared across several picks by different players.

blocked.name: Noctis, Heir Apparent
blocked.why: Warp-Strike's 'return it tapped and attacking at the beginning of that player's next declare attackers step; it can't be blocked that combat' has no flicker return timing (returnAt has no declare-attackers option).

blocked.name: Phoenix Down
blocked.why: A modal activated ability whose modes bring their own targets (reanimate a creature card with mana value 4 or less / exile target Skeleton, Spirit or Zombie), chosen as it's activated (rule 700.2b), isn't expressible.

blocked.name: Quistis Trepe
blocked.why: cast-now has no spendAs, so "mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell" for the card cast from a graveyard as the trigger resolves can't be said.

blocked.name: Qutrub Forayer
blocked.why: The second mode, "exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard", needs a target relation keeping both cards in one graveyard; any-number / other slots can only say different-controller, not same-owner.

blocked.name: Ragnarok, Divine Deliverance
blocked.why: It is the melded back face of Fang, Fearless l'Cie and Vanille, Cheerful l'Cie; the meld layout is not modeled, so the permanent can never exist.

blocked.name: Rejoin the Fight
blocked.why: "Each opponent chooses a creature card in your graveyard that hasn't been chosen", starting with the next opponent: no graveyard-card choice made by other players, one after another, excluding earlier picks.

blocked.name: Relentless X-ATM092
blocked.why: 'Can't be blocked except by three or more creatures': only menace's fixed two exists in combat/blocking.ts (the graveyard return with a finality counter is expressible).

blocked.name: Reno and Rude
blocked.why: The top card is exiled first, then a sacrifice is offered, and only if it was made may the exiled card be played this turn with mana of any type: allow-cast-from-exile is cast-only with no spendAs, and impulse-exile can't grant its permission after a later choice without reordering what the player sees.

blocked.name: Rinoa, Angel Wing
blocked.why: 'Whenever one or more attacking creatures you control die, you may return one of them' needs a batched dies trigger whose effect chooses one of the batch.

blocked.name: Sabin, Master Monk
blocked.why: "Blitz—{2}{R}{R}, Discard a card" (a blitz cost with a discard in it) and "You may cast this card from your graveyard using its blitz ability": blitz takes a mana cost only and is offered only from the hand and the command zone.

blocked.name: Seifer, Balamb Rival
blocked.why: 'Whenever a creature attacking one of your opponents becomes blocked by two or more creatures' — becomes-blocked has no blocker count and no 'attacking one of your opponents' clause.

blocked.name: Sleep Magic
blocked.why: "Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step": the doesntUntap static only covers its own permanent, not the enchanted creature.

blocked.name: Squall, Gunblade Duelist
blocked.why: 'Whenever one or more creatures attack one of your opponents, if any of those creatures have power or toughness equal to the chosen number' needs a per-defender attack batch with an intervening-if over those creatures.

blocked.name: Stolen Uniform
blocked.why: Its reflexive "When you lose control of that Equipment this turn, if it is attached to a creature you control, unattach it" needs a lose-control trigger and an unattach effect, neither of which exists.

blocked.name: Strago and Relm
blocked.why: "If you cast a creature spell this way, it gains haste and 'At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this creature.'": cast-now can't give the spell it casts (and the permanent it becomes) abilities; the reveal-until and free cast themselves are Chaos Wand's shape.

blocked.name: Stuck in Summoner's Sanctum
blocked.why: 'Its activated abilities can't be activated' on the enchanted permanent: the prohibits static takes a CardFilter, and no filter names the permanent this Aura is attached to.

blocked.name: Summon: Brynhildr
blocked.why: Chapter I's "During any turn you put a lore counter on this Saga, you may play that card" is a play permission live only on turns a lore counter goes on the Saga; impulse-exile's durations (end-of-turn, your-next-turn, while-source, while-exiled, ...) have no such window.

blocked.name: Thancred Waters
blocked.why: Royal Guard's indestructible lasts "for as long as you control Thancred Waters"; the only source-bound duration, while-source, doesn't end when control of Thancred changes.

blocked.name: The Destined Black Mage
blocked.why: "If you have a full party, it deals 3 damage to each opponent instead": no party count or full-party condition.

blocked.name: The Destined Thief
blocked.why: 'If you have a full party, instead draw three cards' needs the party count (each creature counted for one party type); a Cleric/Rogue/Warrior/Wizard conjunction would count a Cleric Wizard twice.

blocked.name: The Destined Warrior
blocked.why: 'If you have a full party, creatures you control get +3/+0 instead' needs the party count (each creature counted once), not four subtype checks.

blocked.name: The Destined White Mage
blocked.why: "If you have a full party, put three +1/+1 counters on that creature instead": no party count or full-party condition.

blocked.name: Ultima
blocked.why: "End the turn" (rule 723.1: exile the stack, remove creatures from combat, go to cleanup) has no effect.

blocked.name: Ultimate Magic: Meteor
blocked.why: "For each opponent, choose an artifact or land that player controls. Destroy the chosen permanents": choose-permanents has no per-opponent pick from that player's side, and a for-each-player loop would destroy them one opponent at a time rather than together.

blocked.name: Umaro, Raging Yeti
blocked.why: Its beginning-of-combat mode is chosen at random as the trigger goes on the stack (before its target, per the rulings); modal's random is resolution-time only.

blocked.name: Unexpected Request
blocked.why: "You may attach an Equipment you control to that creature. If you do, unattach it at the beginning of the next end step": no unattach effect (nor a delayed trigger running one on the Equipment chosen as it resolves).

blocked.name: Urianger Augurelt
blocked.why: Draw Arcanum's linked face-down exile and Play Arcanum's "until end of turn, you may play cards exiled with Urianger Augurelt. Spells you cast this way cost {2} less": no activated, this-turn play permission over the source's linked exile, nor a cost reduction tied to that permission.

blocked.name: Vanille, Cheerful l'Cie
blocked.why: Melding with Fang, Fearless l'Cie into Ragnarok, Divine Deliverance (the meld layout) isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Vayne's Treachery
blocked.why: "Kicker—Sacrifice an artifact or creature": kicker.cost is mana only, with no sacrifice kicker cost to read as kicked.

blocked.name: Warrior's Resolve
blocked.why: 'Creatures you control have training' — training isn't modeled (its trigger condition is checked as attackers are declared, not as an intervening-if).

blocked.name: Zidane, Tantalus Thief
blocked.why: "Whenever an opponent gains control of a permanent from you" has no trigger event (control changes fire nothing a trigger can watch, once per permanent).
